notFound.title: Page not found

validation.emailInvalid: Enter your email address, for example name@example.com.
validation.passwordLong_one: Use a password of at most {{count}} character.
validation.passwordLong_other: Use a password of at most {{count}} characters.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are different. Type the same password in both fields.
validation.passwordShort_one: Use a password of at least {{count}} character.
validation.passwordShort_other: Use a password of at least {{count}} characters.

errors.unexpected: Something unexpected happened in the app. Reload the page and try again.

class.reconcile_first: The server may or may not have saved your change. Reload to see the current state before you try again.
class.refresh_preconditions: This is out of date. Reload the page to see the current state, then try again.
class.requires_authorization: You need to sign in, or you do not have permission to do this.
class.safe_same_inputs: That did not go through. Try again in a moment.
class.terminal: The server could not do this. Check what you entered and try something different.
class.unknown: The server could not do this. Try again, and reload the page if it keeps happening.

code.account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the person who runs this service if you think that is a mistake.
code.account_exists: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in instead, or use a different address.
code.email_not_verified: Verify your email address first. Use the link we sent you, or ask for a new one at the top of the page.
code.email_taken: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in instead, or use a different address.
code.forbidden: Your role on this project does not allow that. Ask the project owner for access.
code.github_already_linked: That GitHub account is already linked to a different account here. Sign in with that account instead.
code.github_bad_response: GitHub answered in a way we did not expect. Try again in a few minutes.
code.github_code_rejected: GitHub did not accept the sign-in. Start again with the GitHub button.
code.github_denied: GitHub sign-in was cancelled. Use the GitHub button to try again, or sign in with your email.
code.github_email_conflict: An account with your GitHub email already exists. Sign in with your email and password, then connect GitHub from your account page.
code.github_email_unavailable: GitHub did not share a verified email address. Make an email public or verified on GitHub, or create an account with your email instead.
code.github_not_configured: GitHub sign-in is not set up on this server. Sign in with your email instead.
code.github_state_mismatch: The GitHub sign-in could not be matched to this browser. Start again with the GitHub button.
code.github_unreachable: GitHub could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
code.grace_period_over: The 30 days for restoring this project have passed, so it can no longer be restored.
code.http_5xx: The server had a problem. Wait a moment and try again.
code.http_413: That is larger than the server accepts. Choose a smaller file or fewer files.
code.internal: The server had a problem and may not have saved your change. Reload to check, then try again.
code.invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match. Check both and try again, or reset your password.
code.invalid_request: Something you entered was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
code.invalid_token: This link is not valid any more. Links work once and expire, so ask for a new one.
code.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
code.not_found: We could not find that. It may have been deleted, or the link may be wrong.
code.origin_not_allowed: The server refused this request because it came from a different site. Open HOI4 Factory from its own address and try again.
code.project_pending_deletion: This project is waiting to be deleted. Restore it first if you want to change it.
code.rate_limited_one: Too many attempts. Wait {{count}} second and try again.
code.rate_limited_other: Too many attempts. Wait {{count}} seconds and try again.
code.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in to continue.

unavailable.body: This part of the server is still being built. Nothing you entered is lost, and it will work here once it ships.
unavailable.title: {{what}} is not available yet

auth.passwordHint_other: At least {{count}} characters. A long phrase works well.

reset.askAgain: Ask for a new reset link

reset.requestIntro: Enter the email address of your account and we will send a link to choose a new password.
reset.requestSent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.

projects.emptyBody: A project holds one mod and everything that is done to it. Give it a name to start, then create a new mod, upload one or import one from GitHub.
projects.pendingBody: These projects are waiting to be deleted for good. Restore one before its date to keep it.
projects.title: Projects

project.confirmDelete: Delete <name>{{name}}</name>? It moves to "Waiting to be deleted" for 30 days. You can restore it until then, and after that it is gone for good.
project.deletePending: This project will be deleted soon.
project.deletesOn: Deleted for good on {{date}} unless you restore it.
project.pendingNotice: This project is waiting to be deleted. Restore it to work on it again.
project.readOnly: You can look at this project but not change it. Ask the owner for more access.

workspace.emptyBody: Bring a mod in with one of the options below.
workspace.emptyTitle: No mod in this project yet
workspace.title: Workspace

bring.legend: How do you want to start?
bring.title: Bring in a mod

create.body: Start a new mod from scratch.
create.descriptionHint: A sentence or two is enough. It helps set up the mod's description and conventions.
create.title: Create new

upload.body: Add a mod you already have as a ZIP file or a folder.
upload.done: Uploaded. The mod is in your workspace now.
upload.missing: Choose a ZIP file or a folder first.
upload.title: Upload ZIP or folder

github.body: Import a repository from your connected GitHub account.
github.done: Imported. The repository is in your workspace now.
github.noRepositories: GitHub did not list any repositories for HOI4 Factory to use. Check which repositories you allowed it to see.
github.notLinked: Connect your GitHub account first. We only read the repository you pick, and nothing is pushed.
github.refHint: Leave empty to use the default branch ({{branch}}).
github.refHintGeneric: Leave empty to use the repository's default branch.
github.title: Import from GitHub

setup.title: Review and set up
setup.intro: Setup looks at the mod, then shows exactly what it would create, change or leave alone. Nothing is written until you apply the plan.
setup.scanDone: The scan finished. Nothing needed your attention.
setup.incomplete: The scan stopped early because of a limit, so this picture is incomplete. Treat anything missing as unchecked, not as fine.
setup.planIntro: A dry run lists every change before it happens.
setup.tableCaption: Files Setup would create, change or leave alone
setup.nothingToChange: Setup has nothing to change in this mod.
setup.conflicts: Some files conflict with what Setup wants to write. Setup will not overwrite them. Resolve the conflicts before you apply.
setup.confirm_one: Apply exactly this plan? {{n}} file will be created or changed.
setup.confirm_other: Apply exactly this plan? {{n}} files will be created or changed.

result.failed: Applying the plan failed. Nothing is marked as done. Run the scan again to see where things stand.
result.needs_rollback: Setup stopped part way and cannot safely continue from there. Roll the change back before you try again.
